about.title: Our Story
about.imageAlt: Bonjour Cafe team preparing specialty coffee
paragraphs: Bonjour Cafe started with a simple idea - bring people together over a great cup of coffee. What began as a small stand in Chisinau's Central Park has grown into six cozy locations across the city, each one carrying the same warmth and love for quality that we started with.

We source our beans directly from trusted farmers, roast them locally, and train every barista to craft each drink with precision and care. From your morning espresso to a lazy weekend latte - every cup at Bonjour is made to brighten your day.

mobileBanner.text: We offer a selection of coffee beans from over 20 different countries!

testimonials.subtitle: Don't just take our word for it - hear from the people who make our mornings brighter.

items.text: The best cappuccino in Chisinau, hands down! The atmosphere is so warm and welcoming. I come here every morning before work.
items.name: Ana Popescu

items.text: Perfect spot for remote work - great Wi-Fi, comfy seats, and the caramel latte is absolutely addictive. Highly recommend!
items.name: Mihai Rusu

items.text: The croissants are unreal - crispy outside, buttery inside. Combined with their flat white, it's the perfect breakfast combo.
items.name: Elena Ciobanu
